name: agentcode-heavy
description: Multi-file, long-horizon agent work. Trained on every trajectory, including the longest. MoE: 80B of knowledge at roughly 3B-per-token inference cost.

lora._target_modules_note: Attention plus the shared expert. Adapting all 512 routed experts multiplies adapter size for little gain. Check the names with print(model) before a long run.

hardware: train: 1x 80GB GPU (H100/A100) with 4-bit QLoRA, 2x 80GB for 32k context. serve: 2x 80GB (bf16) or 1x 80GB (FP8)
